agent.problem: The card opens with the first-person quotation "I am the only one left, and they are seeking my life as well" without identifying Elijah as the speaker before the quotation.

rule.text: When he quotes someone speaking as "I," he says who it is first.

agent.problem: Discovery questions are overused, leaving too many picks to luck rather than reasoning from the earlier cards. For example, the setups give no basis for picking Beersheba (stop 1, card 6), bread rather than figs or raisins (stop 1, card 12), forty (stop 1, card 17), wind (stop 2, card 5), fire (stop 2, card 7), Hazael and Jehu (stop 3, cards 2-3), seven thousand (stop 3, card 5), or the slaughter of the oxen (stop 3, card 12). Several true-or-false picks are similarly unsupported, so this goes beyond a few discovery questions.

rule.text: Before each choice card, Papa Dorin's story card gives enough context that the baker can reason their way to the answer. A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.
